status: Rules 12 and protocol 4. The game's own service made 1,094 English/Chinese GPT-6 Luna evaluation attempts. Three permanent Workers were checked. The deployed live Worker is disabled. See the full-build section of HANDOFF.md.
ai_use: Claude authored the game and the initial proxy and added typing, push-to-talk and the OpenAI route. Codex migrated autonomous dialogue and verified the runtime on 2026-11-14. Claude transferred the source into this repository on 2026-11-15. Codex ran the first live OpenAI test and corrected generated-speech feedback on 2026-11-15.
purpose: Generate the patient's own dialogue and reactions from character context and conversation history.
context_sources: case identity, background, voice, work and reason for visiting
up to 48 doctor, patient and reaction entries from the current visit
latest player words or a game event with its required outcome
earned SPEECH or TEMPER sign when available

response_contract.status: Godot owns physical readings, actions, outcomes, scoring and codes. It validates a named outcome. An open first tool request can be accepted or declined by the patient.

implemented_fields.cooperates: Boolean on a tool request or named outcome. It must match a game-owned grant, refusal, answer or dodge.

response_contract.graded_ask: Graded ASK uses the case's authored answer. Other dialogue is generated in character.

validation: Check JSON, lengths, permitted fields, outcome agreement and deadlines. A foreground failure uses the labelled authored fallback. Optional turns allow silence.

limits.source: game/data/rules.json (agent) and agent_proxy/src/core.mjs (DEFAULT_LIMITS); change both together

budgets.status: E1–E4 used 1,094 attempts under a USD 50 approval. Their conservative reservation was USD 0.595195. The intent and dialogue medians were 754 and 1,293 ms.

fallback: Authored offline comparison/fallback, separately labelled in UI and logs; no substitution on successful model replies.
memory_policy: Last 48 conversation entries in memory per visit; reset for the next patient; no server-side cross-visit transcript.

design_target.loop: Choose optional observation, actions or dialogue; compare observations and speech; continue, approve surgery or call Trauma Team.
design_target.agent_role: Autonomously generate the reply and reaction; no enumerated reply choices.
design_target.hypothesis: Believable, context-sensitive conversations change the next player action.
design_target.comparison: Authored dialogue with the same backgrounds and scenarios.
open: whether new patients encourage conversational follow-ups in human play
human shutter timing and how it affects the value of the second PRESS
student reading of the synthetic E2 answers and the outside-player E6 comparison

historical_evidence: November 12: 269 game, 141 UI, 28 proxy and 73 mock integration checks of the older constrained protocol; no autonomous-dialogue validation is claimed.

speech_to_text.route: POST /v1/transcribe on the same proxy; push-to-talk only, never always-on
speech_to_text.privacy: Clips stay in memory and are never written to disk; logs hold lengths and stages, never words or audio.
speech_to_text.status: Push-to-talk and review-before-send are available on a voice-capable local service. The November 15 OpenAI run transcribed ten clips of synthetic speech. The November 21 evaluation did not send audio. Public Workers disable transcription.

providers.default: The game starts with authored patients. Its menu connects to the permanent public mock when enabled.
providers.google: Gemini API key, or Vertex AI with an OAuth access token from gcloud application-default credentials; default model gemini-3.5-flash-lite
providers.openai: API key only (ChatGPT sign-in does not use API credit); default models gpt-6-luna and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
providers.status: The shipped live launcher selects OpenAI gpt-6-luna. Real OpenAI results for November 15 and 21 are recorded in HANDOFF.md. Google/Vertex only have simulated provider tests.

intent_routing.confirmed_ask: A paid inference displays the question and price. The player can confirm, speak for free or choose another question.
intent_routing.pressure: Only the PRESS action spends pressure lamps.
